evidence.quote: A Flag Station on the GTPR

evidence.supports: Andimaul is 158 miles from Rupert on the railway

notes_for_editor: Story is below the 120-word floor: no fetched source describes Andimaul's build, staffing, fires or closure. A BC Archives record (I-70086, a 1977 fire detection lookout photograph, elevation 533) and a second photograph titled as a view from the lookout (W shot 7) were seen only in search snippets; the archives pages return a certificate error, so neither is quoted. The gent.name page names the place as a flag station but does not connect the lookout to it, so the story does not. The BC Forest Service lookout card file (described by Parminter) could hold the build data; it was not reached.
